description: Department of Local Government - Central Province - Kandy Municipal Council Entertainment Tax
reasoning: This gazette notification amends the entertainment tax rates for the Kandy Municipal Council area. It involves regulatory changes to tax ordinances (Entertainment Tax Ordinance No. 12 of 1946 and Amendment Act No. 37 of 1984) and establishes new compliance requirements for entertainment activities. This falls under Legal/Regulatory matters as it modifies existing regulations and sets new tax rates.
